description: In every PA-model, nonzero recognized term-depth decomposes its actual code into a free-name leaf, bound-slot leaf, auxiliary leaf, zero, successor or binary arithmetic constructor, with valid term children.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth_cases.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (e : M)
  (he :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth e ≠
      Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) :
  (∃ a, e = Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 0 [a]) ∨
    (∃ a, e = Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 1 [a]) ∨
      (∃ a, e = Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 8 [a]) ∨
        e =
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 2
              [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 0] ∨
          (∃ a,
              e =
                  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 2
                    [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1, a] ∧
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth a ≠
                  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∨
            ∃ f,
              (f = 2 ∨ f = 3) ∧
                ∃ a b,
                  e =
                      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.modelNode 2
                        [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M f, a, b] ∧
                    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth a ≠
                        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M ∧
                      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.SyntaxPrograms.termDepth b ≠
                        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M
